method: Downloaded complete primary HTMLs; inspected income/cash-flow table rows, annual column headers and selected business passages. Reopened every row-based numerical evidence locator against retained snapshots and independently recomputed formula inputs in test_model.py.
verified: Calendar vs NVIDIA January / Microsoft June / Apple September fiscal ends
Microsoft release last two columns are annual, not quarterly
Cash outflows made positive for comparison; cash-flow deficits retain negative sign
R&D never added to cash capex as total investment; Amazon technology expense excluded from pure R&D
Meta old gross purchases less proceeds tie to newer comparative net presentation
Amazon gross-to-net capex and disclosed FCF tie
Meta financing lease principal bridges to disclosed FCF
Groq license cash is not acquisition of Groq equity and not an additional equity investment
Unreported components remain missing, not zero; zero dividends/repurchases supported by policy or complete financing statements
Opinion strength reviewed against disclosed business scope
disclosed_limitations: Windows are issuer-specific, not a synchronized calendar five-year panel.
Latest Microsoft annual result source is an unaudited SEC-filed earnings release.
No 2026/2027 interim updates or management budgets mixed into annual series.
Strategic investment recipient breakdown and AI-only capex are incomplete in public disclosure.
Company-specific gross/net, intangibles and leases prevent a fully uniform economic investment measure.
Source and narrative review performed by the authoring agent; no accuracy percentage or independent assurance.
